name: apiclaw
description: The API layer for AI agents. 26,704 discoverable APIs, 2,895 empirically callable (49 fully managed). Zero config.
long_description: APIClaw is a unified gateway that gives your AI agent access to tens of thousands of APIs through one MCP server. 2,895 are empirically callable — every one verified by smoketest (HTTP 200 + parseable JSON). 49 of those are fully managed where APIClaw owns the keys (OpenAI, Anthropic, OpenRouter, xAI, Replicate, ElevenLabs, Brave Search, Firecrawl, GitHub, APILayer's 27 sub-APIs, plus more). Universal pass-through proxy for keyless public APIs. Includes capability-based routing, circuit breakers, SSRF protection, and full request logging. Built on Convex. Free tier with 25 API calls per month, email signup required.

tools.name: discover_apis
tools.description: Search 26,704 APIs by capability. Returns ranked matches; pass callable_only=true to filter to verified-working.

tools.name: call_api
tools.description: Execute any callable API through APIClaw. Auth handled automatically for managed providers.

tools.name: get_api_details
tools.description: Full specs, pricing, limits, and auth details for a specific API.

tools.name: list_connected
tools.description: List all managed providers ready for instant calls.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Browse APIs by category (AI, search, voice, communication, etc.).

tools.name: capability
tools.description: Route by capability (validate email, convert currency, transcribe audio). APIClaw picks the best provider.

tools.name: estimate_cost
tools.description: Estimate cost of a call before executing.
